resolved_earlier_findings.auditor_judgement: Accepted, and the suggestion was right independently of who made it: the spaced form is this catalogue's VERB phrase (साइन इन करें), while the noun is hyphenated in this band's own description and in the batch's other noun uses (ui.chat.status.credential_refused, ui.common.connection). The amendment also removes a real ambiguity: without the hyphen, 'साइन इन नहीं है' can be read as the negated verb ('has not signed in') rather than 'there is no sign-in'. The title keeps {label} first, which Hindi requires, and stays punctuation-free as the sidecar's tone asks.
